receipt_authority.note: the registered 2026-08-11 SCEDC receipt records HTTP 200 for this endpoint/query shape; the final probe changes ONLY the date window to the registered historical probe day

constraints: exactly ONE request; no sta/station param, split, alternate bbox/host/method/day, or fallback; on HTTP error the error body from the SAME transaction is read and pinned (not a second request); on any refusal socal remains PROVIDER_GRAMMAR_UNAVAILABLE (never absent) and STOPS -- no fourth request, no synthetic absence
